hints.text: Check the variable part of each term. When the variable parts match, the terms can be combined.
Both terms are $x$-terms, so add the numbers in front and keep the $x$: work out $4 + 3$.

explanation: $4x$ and $3x$ are like terms because they have the same variable part, $x$.
Like terms are combined by adding their coefficients: $4 + 3 = 7$.
The variable part stays the same, so the answer is $7x$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Sticker sorting
steps: Picture 4 apple stickers and 3 more apple stickers — all the same kind.
Same kind means you can count them together: 7 apple stickers, so 7x.

alternativeExplanations.title: Test a value
steps: And 7x = 14 too — the shorter form gives the same value, so 7x is right.
